description: Maps Lane A (#532): a property-proximity question ('which of my properties are near <place>') must reach the properties_near mirror tool. properties_near is mocked so the reply is deterministic and the tool's real runtime Maps-key/PostGIS requirements don't apply in the harness (same mocking pattern as 040's buildium_get_property). Quality/K-of-N assertions only — the agent legitimately surfaces its own properties to the user, so no must-never applies. Dogfood-proven (20/20 live-Gemini grid) and single-run-gated.
